subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Should OpenClaw core own a built-in Gateway watchdog and recovery ladder, and which recovery actions are allowed by default versus explicit opt-in?
rationale: The remaining work adds new core recovery semantics, config surface, service restart or repair behavior, and diagnostic notification policy that cannot be selected safely from source inspection alone.

options.title: Keep As Design Umbrella
options.body: Use this issue to settle the core product and security design, then review narrower watchdog, health probe, doctor auto-fix, and crash-ladder work against that design.

options.title: Split To Canonical Slices
options.body: Move each remaining behavior to narrower open issues and close this only after the broad security and product context is preserved there.

options.title: Keep Recovery External
options.body: Document an external supervisor or plugin pattern instead of adding core watchdog semantics if maintainers decide this should not live in OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle the core product and security design, then review narrower watchdog, health probe, doctor auto-fix, and crash-ladder work against that design.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history on restart protection, unhandled errors, and broad Gateway runtime ownership signals for this product/security decision.
